jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description_text: At the heart of Mirego’s growth, your role as a Business Development Representative for the Toronto area is essential to identifying and qualifying new opportunities. As the first point of contact for current and prospective clients, you build strong, engaging relationships while clearly communicating the value of our solutions. Your primary objective is to target and engage prospects, drawing a deep understanding of their needs and aligning them with Mirego’s service offerings. You will also contribute to managing and growing existing accounts, ensuring the successful delivery of ongoing projects and identifying additional opportunities.

jobs.title: Chargé(e) de projets agiles
jobs.description_text: Chez Mirego, nous croyons profondément en une approche itérative souple et collaborative de la création de produits numériques. Faire évoluer nos produits par petits pas, avec une rétroaction constante de l'équipe et de nos clients, c'est pour nous la façon la plus efficace de créer de la vraie valeur. En tant que chargé·e de projet Agile, tu es au cœur de cette dynamique. Tu accompagnes l’équipe tout au long de la réalisation des projets, identifies les obstacles en cours de route et veilles à l’amélioration continue de leur processus de travail. Tu sais motiver les équipes pour assurer la livraison des projets de manière optimale, tout en respectant le budget, le calendrier et la portée.

jobs.title: Contrôleur(e) financier(ère)
jobs.description_text: En tant que Contrôleur·e financier·ère, tu assures la rigueur, la fiabilité et l'amélioration continue de l'information financière qui sert à la prise de décision. Tu agis comme partenaire d'affaires auprès des équipes, en traduisant les données financières en analyses claires et actionnables qui éclairent la rentabilité, les marges et les coûts. Tu profites de chaque occasion pour moderniser les façons de faire de la fonction finance, en tirant parti des outils technologiques et de l'intelligence artificielle pour simplifier le travail de ton équipe. Tu sais que ton succès se mesure à une information financière plus fiable et plus rapidement disponible, à une rentabilité mieux comprise et mieux suivie, et à une équipe qui adopte avec enthousiasme de nouveaux outils. Ce poste est pour toi si tu souhaites grandir avec la fonction finance et prendre éventuellement plus de responsabilités dans un contexte d'entreprise en évolution.

jobs.title: Senior Security Lead
jobs.description_text: At Lendbuzz, we believe financial opportunity should be more personalized and fair. We develop innovative technologies that provide underserved and overlooked borrowers with better access to credit. From our employees to our dealers, partners, and borrowers, we’ve built a company and a culture around a resolute belief in the promise and power of diversity. We value independent and critical thinking. We're looking for a Senior Security Lead to partner closely with our CISO in driving Lendbuzz's security strategy and running the day-to-day of the security function. You'll own the execution of key initiatives, keep the security program on track, and work with senior stakeholders across the company to make security part of how we build and operate. This role suits someone who combines strong technical depth with excellent communication skills and strong project management capabilities. You'll have broad scope, high visibility, and a direct impact on how security works at Lendbuzz.

jobs.title: Avionics Technician
jobs.description_text: LTA Research and Exploration, an aerospace start-up, is seeking an Avionics Technician specializing in systems integration on research and development flight vehicles. In order to help advance our goal of bringing revolutionary airships to life, the Avionics Technician will work directly with the appropriate company personnel to organize, plan, and execute the troubleshooting, installation, and inspections of various subsystems. This position will also provide flight operational support as required. The base range for this role is $45-62/hr, which is determined based on experience, geography, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes a very competitive annual bonus, 401K Match, and other generous benefits. While we believe competitive compensation is a critical aspect of your decision to join us, we do hope you also spend time considering why our mission and culture are right for you.

jobs.title: Director of Agricultural Development
jobs.description_text: Rainmaker is pioneering a modern precipitation enhancement cloud seeding system to solve water scarcity. We develop and incorporate radar validation, weather-resistant UAS, and numerical weather modeling to make water abundant. As Rainmaker’s Director of Agricultural Development, you will own our engagement with the U.S. Department of Agriculture and the agricultural community in Washington. You will build the programs, partnerships, and funding pathways that connect precipitation enhancement to the conservation and water supply needs of American producers, and you will own the Congressional relationships and coalition presence that make the work durable. This position is based in Washington, DC. Significant stock options with high potential upside as an early-stage company 401(k) with employer matching Full health coverage (medical, dental, and vision insurance) Relocation assistance provided (if applicable) Unlimited PTO Paid parental leave for both parents

jobs.title: Director of International Development
jobs.description_text: Rainmaker is pioneering a modern precipitation enhancement cloud seeding system to solve water scarcity. We develop and incorporate radar validation, weather-resistant UAS, and numerical weather modeling to make water abundant. As Rainmaker’s Director of International Development, you will be the bridge between Rainmaker’s International Team and the U.S. federal government. You will own our engagement with the Department of State by building the programs, partnerships, and funding pathways that pair American precipitation enhancement technology with the water security needs of partner nations. Water scarcity is a geopolitical problem before it is a technical one. Rainmaker’s goal is to make American cloud seeding the technology partner nations turn to, and this role is how we get there in Washington. This position is based in Washington, DC and works as an embedded member of the International Team. Benefits: Significant stock options with high potential upside as an early-stage company 401(k) with employer matching Full health coverage (medical, dental, and vision insurance) Relocation assistance provided (if applicable) Unlimited PTO Paid parental leave for both parents

jobs.title: Director of Science Policy
jobs.description_text: Rainmaker is pioneering a modern precipitation enhancement cloud seeding system to solve water scarcity. We develop and incorporate radar validation, weather-resistant UAS, and numerical weather modeling to make water abundant. As Rainmaker’s Director of Science Policy, you will own our engagement with the federal science enterprise, such as DOE, NOAA, NSF, and the research offices and national laboratories that fund atmospheric science in the United States. You will find the programs where our work and their priorities meet, build the proposals that win them, and own the Congressional and community relationships that make that work durable. Rainmaker is building the best atmospheric science lab in the world. This role connects that ambition to the agencies funding the parallel research. This position is based in Washington, DC. Significant stock options with high potential upside as an early-stage company 401(k) with employer matching Full health coverage (medical, dental, and vision insurance) Relocation assistance provided (if applicable) Unlimited PTO Paid parental leave for both parents

jobs.title: Director of Water Development
jobs.description_text: Rainmaker is pioneering a modern precipitation enhancement cloud seeding system to solve water scarcity. jobs.description_text:
Chez Lyft, notre raison d'être est de servir et de connecter. Lyft Urban Solutions conçoit, fabrique et exploite des systèmes de vélopartage dans plus de 50 villes à travers le monde, dont New York, Chicago, Londres, Barcelone, Mexico, Rio de Janeiro et Montréal. Notre usine de Longueuil est le berceau de BIXI, le premier système de vélopartage automatisé en Amérique du Nord, et fabrique aujourd'hui les vélos et les stations de certains des plus grands réseaux de vélopartage au monde.

Nous recherchons un ou une stagiaire en ingénierie de la qualité terrain, matériel pour se joindre à notre équipe Qualité terrain (Field Quality) à notre établissement de Longueuil. Une fois que nos vélos, vélos électriques, batteries et stations quittent l'usine, l'équipe Qualité terrain est responsable de leur comportement en conditions réelles : des millions de trajets, en toutes saisons, dans des villes partout dans le monde. Our work centers on four pillars: AD/ADAS, our autonomous driving and advanced driver assist technologies; Arene, our software development platform for software-defined vehicles; Woven City, a test course for mobility; and Cloud & AI, the digital infrastructure powering our collaborative foundation. Business-critical functions empower these teams to execute, and together, we’re working toward one bold goal: a world with zero accidents and enhanced well-being for all. =========================================================================

jobs.description_text: Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. You will be responsible for winning new logos, maintaining and growing our existing business, and managing strategic relationships at an HQ/affiliate level within the region. A strong understanding of the life science industry, B2B sales cycles and a passion forsolving business issues with innovative data and technology is ideal.
